KELAS KENDERAAN

Kelas 1 : Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda

 (tidak termasuk teksi dan bas)

Kelas 2 : Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan lima atau enam roda

 (tidak termasuk bas)

Kelas 3 : Kenderaan yang mempunyai tiga gandar atau lebih (tidak termasuk bas)

Kelas 4 : Teksi

Kelas 5 : Bas

Bagi maksud mengira bilangan gandar dan roda sesuatu kenderaan, gandar dan roda

mana-mana treler yang ditarik oleh kenderaan itu hendaklah termasuk sebagai

sebahagian daripada gandar dan roda kenderaan itu. ".

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(SENAI-PASIR GUDANG-DESARU EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru Expressway) (Amendment)

Order 2014.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 1 January 2014.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Senai-Pasir Gudang-Desaru Expressway) Order 2011 [P.U. (A) 231/2011] is amended

by substituting for the First Schedule the following Schedule:

CLASS OF VEHICLE

Class 1 : Vehicles having two axles and three or four wheels (excluding taxis and buses)

Class 2 : Vehicles having two axles and five or six wheels (excluding buses)

Class 3 : Vehicle having three axles or more (excluding buses)

Class 4 : Taxis

Class 5 : Buses

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be included as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicles. ".
